culture.text: Makes blood pressure monitors, nebulisers, thermometers and other health monitoring devices, with over 300 million blood pressure monitors sold.
The Hoofddorp office has about 224 people and serves Europe, Russia, the Middle East and Africa; the group is based in Kyoto.
Staff mostly work in sales, operations, business development and marketing; top schools include University of Amsterdam and RSM Erasmus.
